text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model v4-encoder-quant -> 10% traffic at 08:42 PT. rolling out in region-us-west. monitor p95/p99 and streaming stalls.

Alex Nguyen: seeing p99 increase on canary shards, starting to surface at ~30s tail for streaming endpoints. p95 also drifting.

Maria Lopez: tagging @Alex. stack: v4-encoder-quant + encoder-kernel-optimized. any recent infra changes?

Kai Zhang: no infra deploys this window. I see a KV eviction spike in the canary pool around rollout start. possible kv cache thrash when new tokenizer mapping loaded.

Alex Nguyen: confirmed. logs show repeated kv cache misses + cold loads. sample log:
```
[canary-shard-12] cache_miss key=tok_map_v4 size=12MB load_ms=1234
[canary-shard-12] kv_put token_map refreshed
```

oncall-sre: paging per playbook. @Maria you on-call for infra? should we scale burst or hold rollout? :pager:

Maria Lopez: I'm here. initial customer impact: two power-usage customers reported slow streaming for embeddings and chat multi-turns. CS flagged increased timeouts at p99.

incidents-bot: Incident triggered: LATENCY_P99_SPIKE (severity: sevp-2). Pages sent to oncall-sre and infra-deploy.

infra-deploy: quick check — autoscaler did not kick because seen memory pressure due to model mapped files. we can try temporary traffic-shaping to 5% and force kv warm-up.

Alex Nguyen: Agree. Plan: 1) shift canary down to 5% 2) run warm-up job to prepopulate tok_map on canary nodes 3) monitor p99 & streaming stall rate. If no improvement in 8m -> rollback.

product-ops: Heads up — we're seeing some 504s surface in dashboards. Suggest notifying impacted customers after mitigation decision.

Maria Lopez: initiating traffic shift now.

infra-deploy: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/rollout/shapeshift -d '{"delta_percent": -5, "target": "canary"}'` -> ok, traffic at 5%.

Kai Zhang: running warm-up job: `for host in $(cat canary-hosts); do ssh $host "curl http://localhost:8080/preload?map=tok_map_v4" & done`

Alex Nguyen: warming runs showing tok_map loads finishing; eviction rate dropping. p99 trending down from 1.2s to 520ms over last 90s. p95 back to baseline.

customer-success: CS ping: two customers (AcmeAnalytics, HealthFlow) saw degraded throughput, asking for ETA.

Alex Nguyen: telling CS ETA ~10-15m pending stable p99 under SLO and no stream stalls.

oncall-sre: capture metrics snapshot and add to incident:
- baseline p99: 260ms
- spike p99: 1.2s
- current p99: 520ms
- streaming stall count: spike-> 86, current -> 12

ops-oncall: do we want to continue canary at 5% for now or perform partial rollback to v3.9-encoder?

Maria Lopez: if warm-up keeps p99 > 400ms we roll back. Right now trending ok but still above baseline. recommend hold at 5% for 15m and run synthetic long-chain streams.

Alex Nguyen: running synthetic test: sending 500 long-streaming sessions to canary pool. results so far: 98% completion within 800ms, few stalls but none exceeding 2s.

infra-deploy: note: the quantized kernel path increased memory footprint slightly which pushed kv eviction threshold. downstream effect on token_map thrash. mitigation options: reduce `max_cached_files` to force earlier eviction of less important files, or increase node memory (hard).

Kai Zhang: quick config to lower cached files applied on canary nodes: `sysctl set service.encoder.max_cached_files=32` -> applied. eviction stabilizing.

Alex Nguyen: p99 now 340ms, streaming stalls down to 4 in last 5m. Good.

product-ops: agree, prepare for slow rollout resume with explicit warm-up and a prewarm job in rollout pipeline. Also add canary health gate: kv_miss_rate < 0.02 and streaming_stall_rate < 0.005.

incidents-bot: Incident status: Mitigated (under observation). No customer-facing rollback done.

customer-success: Notifying AcmeAnalytics + HealthFlow with update: investigating, mitigation applied, ETA 15m. will follow up.

ops-oncall: I'll stay on this thread for the handoff. @Maria you're primary for the next hour?

Maria Lopez: yes — taking handoff. leaving notes: warm-up job in pipeline `canary-prewarm-v4`, `max_cached_files=32` set. monitor kv_miss_rate & streaming stalls. escalate to infra if p99 > 500ms for >10m.

Alex Nguyen: creating incident ticket IR-246800 on board, attaching metrics and synthetic logs.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic resumed to 15% after warm-up checks at 09:08 PT. monitor.

Alex Nguyen: final check: p99 310ms, p95 120ms, streaming stalls 1 in last 10m. closing incident as resolved but keeping watch for 2 hours.

Maria Lopez: handoff to next shift @ops-oncall at 10:30 PT. I'll update runbook with kv warm-up step. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: acknowledged. will monitor dashboards and alert if regressions reappear.

incidents-bot: Incident closed (sevp-2 -> mitigated).
_meta: Slack thread generated for dataset: canary-induced tail latency spike, mitigation and handoff. messages are chronological, include bots, code snippets, and customer impact notes.
